note: Adjudicated accidental variants: ten of punctuation and two of orthography, where witnesses do and handmissal-eo spell quotidiánum for the cotidiánum of the approved Benziger printing. Substantive text agrees across all three witnesses with zero divergence. Because the Mass wording follows that page, it is not letter for letter the prayer on its own (orationes.pater-noster), which spells quotidiánum and is pointed differently at six places.

adjudicated.ruling: The approved Benziger printing's punctuation is retained. The difference marks phrasing and does not change the words.
